validation.method: V8 CommonJS deterministic regression; Node CLI not executed

worldSeedFormula: mixSeed32(1534940000 XOR imul(dealSeed,0x9e3779b9) XOR imul(seat+1,0x85ebca6b) XOR worldIndex)
selection: Fresh 3x9 full trajectories; stock empty, focal >=2 stones, next opponent 1-8 stones. Select highest X across all turns per deal/seat trajectory, prioritizing X=6 and then smaller next hand. Early and late positions stratified; no synthetic hands; two legal arms, same worlds and two continuation bots.
otherX: Summary only for X=4,5; replay exact seed windows with simulator/connector-high-x-broad-runner.js to recover all rows.
finding: Independent broad-state replication of legal X-X versus X-Y positive pip-gap choices, split by next opponent 2-4 versus 5-8 stones. Differences are observational within provisional number-lock engine; cannot attribute effect solely to opening a branch.
confidence: Exploratory 95% deal-cluster normal half-widths, uncorrected for subgroup testing; matched sampled hidden worlds but noncausal legal-action contrast; two simple bots; selected states not representative of all hands.
limitations: Number-lock geometry unverified, block winner/loneZero/bust/101-match scoring unvalidated, action-choice likelihood omitted from hidden posterior, legal arms retain different stones, finish-first != match win. One-stone stratum not supported if empty.
nextHypothesis: Use independent seeds >=1547740 to test if 6-6 legal choice disadvantage persists specifically in 2-4-stone next-opponent endgames, with preregistered stratification and deal-cluster uncertainty; seek authentic four-branch and block-scoring fixtures.
